initial.name: creator_prepare
initial.description: Show an inline design preview before implementing a new Creator design: expected effect, usage, and proposed placement for UI changes. This preview is required even with Search first off and does not ask for confirmation. With Search first on, also search configured plugin indexes; follow nextAction to compare candidates or implement directly. Does not install plugins.

outcome.description: In the user’s language, briefly describe the finished capability and expected output. State access or persistence limits relevant to its use.

usage.description: In the user’s language, explain where to start and one concrete interaction, e.g. ask “搜索 B 站的 Vue 教程” to receive video links in the conversation.

query.description: Primary capability keyword, e.g. notes. Avoid combining implementation requirements into one query.

alternatives.description: Alternative short queries, including synonyms and the user’s language, e.g. 笔记 and 便签. Search independently and merge results; at most 2 alternatives.

indexes.description: Optional configured index URLs to search, at most 3. Omit for the first configured sources. Use omitted sources only when the user asks to expand discovery.

location.description: Only for UI requests: proposed region to explain in the conversation.

impact.description: For UI requests, explain the user-visible change and affected neighbors in the user’s language.
